reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but takeover duplicates unlinking state changes and transaction downloading copies Akahu.

duplication.why: The change duplicates holder-selection SQL, account-detachment fields, transaction-download orchestration, and initial-balance calculation.

placement.why: Changes follow existing account, sync, configuration, and model layers, although shared linking policy still requires explicit invocation by every provider adapter.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested linking rules, takeover option, and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared linking remains useful, but duplicated detachment and download logic create multiple places to maintain equivalent policies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkBankSyncAccount reproduces unlinkAccount's local field clearing; extracting a shared local-detachment operation would preserve reuse without invoking provider removal.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with provider names changed and the response temporary simplified, rather than sharing the common download operation.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink is threaded into assertNotLinkedElsewhere and linkBankSyncAccount; the guard adds nested target-present/target-closed branches and the linking helper adds a takeover branch, while all six provider adapters still use the shared helpers.
